raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Relied on a misleading DuckDuckGo snippet that stated Arthur Gore, 1st Earl of Arran, was the son of Sir Arthur Gore, 1st Baronet, without clicking through to verify. This contradicts the well-documented fact (and even the snippet noting he was the 3rd Baronet) that his father was the 2nd Baronet. The unverified, incorrect extraction led directly to the wrong identification of the 2nd Earl’s paternal grandfather.
